name: trip_intake_v1
notes: Every question is sent as one message with quick_replies (text type, title <= 20 chars, max 13).
Payload format: <FIELD>:<VALUE>. Store the value on the contact; skip any question whose field is already filled.
Typed answers are allowed at every step: run the extractor (system_prompts.extractor) and fill any fields it finds, then continue with the next unanswered question.
Each user tap or message restarts Meta's 24 h window. Human replies after the 24 h window must use the HUMAN_AGENT tag (7 days).
source = place + video the contact commented on (e.g. panlong / A), set by the comment trigger.

entry.after: place_guide (sent right after the GUIDE:{place} tap)
entry.text: Is China on your travel list? 👀

a_open.text: Love it! ✈️ Tap a few answers and our local team will show you places that'll make you go wow 🤩

a_see.text: What do you most want to see?

a_enjoy.text: What do you enjoy most on a trip?

a_when.text: When are you thinking of coming?

a_reveal.traveller_type: generated by system_prompts.traveller_type from the 6 answers
a_reveal.on_typed_reply: save as must_do (append if several messages), reply 'Got it! Added to your plan ✍️'
on_enter: notify team with all fields + source
hand the conversation to a human (bot stays quiet except PLAN keyword)

b_open.text: Nice! What can I help with?

c_open.text: No rush 🙂 We post a new place every day. Comment the keyword on any video for its guide, or type PLAN when you're ready.

keywords.PLAN: a_open (resume at the first unanswered question)

system_prompts.extractor: You read one Instagram DM from a traveller and return JSON with any of these fields you can fill with confidence, else omit them: want_to_see (landmarks|old_towns_temples|nature|city), enjoy_most (sightseeing|food_local_life|activities|shopping_cafes), famous_or_hidden (famous|hidden|mix), when (0_3m|3_6m|6m_plus|unsure; today's date is given), length (under_week|8_14d|2w_plus), who (solo|couple|friends|family), must_do (free text of specific wishes). Never guess.
system_prompts.traveller_type: Name the traveller in 2-3 words + one emoji from their answers, e.g. Hidden-Spot Hunter 📸, Old-Town Wanderer 🏮, Food-First Explorer 🍜, Skyline Chaser 🌃, Nature Seeker 🌿, Landmark Collector 🏯. Plain, warm, no puns. Output: {"traveller_type": "...", "emoji": "..."}

notes: Same rules on Instagram (comments on IG media) and Facebook (comments on Page posts/reels).
Match the keyword case-insensitively anywhere in the comment, emoji allowed (e.g. 'wow!!', 'Dragon 🐉').
Per post: the keyword sends the guide for THAT post's place. Old posts all say WOW, so WOW is mapped per post id.
Send exactly one private reply per comment (Meta allows one, within 7 days). Do not DM the same person twice for the same post.

private_reply.text:
Hey {first_name}! {place_emoji} Thanks for commenting on {place_name}.
I put together a quick guide: when to go, what to eat, and how to get there. Want it?
private_reply.rule: Postback / quick-reply button only. A URL button does not open the 24 h window.

nudge.if: tapped the guide button but never answered the entry question
nudge.text: Quick one before this chat closes: is a China trip on the cards? 🙂

panlong.text:
🐉 PANLONG TIANDI: quick guide
📍 Metro Line 17 → Panlong Road, exit 3, then a 5-min walk over the footbridge
🎟 Free to walk in, shops open 10 am–10 pm
⏰ Arrive about an hour before sunset. Take the boat first (boats stop 6 pm weekdays, 8 pm weekends), then stay for the lanterns
🚣 Rowing boat: about $7 one way, $14 return
🛶 Floating market: Friday–Sunday and public holidays
📸 Photo spots: the reflection at the 700-year-old Xianghua Bridge, the covered Yanyu Bridge, the lanterns on Fenglai Bridge
🍜 Eat: Fuhe Noodles (Dianping must-eat list 4 years running, about $5 a bowl), yakitori at Niaoxun by the canal (about $20 per person)
🐶 Dog-friendly

gatem.text:
🏭 GATE M (West Bund Dream Center): quick guide
📍 Metro Line 11 → Longyao Road, exit 4, then walk along the river
🎟 Free to walk around
⏰ Best at blue hour, right after sunset, when the old cement silos light up
🔥 Wild Dock: apple-wood charcoal grill inside the silos, about $25 per person. Book ahead for the river terrace
🕶 Gentle Monster: giant face sculptures, worth a look even if you don't shop
🌿 Bloomarket: waterside food market, 30+ small food brands, 11 am–10 pm
🌉 800 m riverfront facing Lupu Bridge
🐶 Very dog-friendly
verify_before_live: metro exit (video says exit 4; one source says exit 2)
